role_in_survey: trajectory-dependent step reward for search agents

role_in_survey: entropy-located outlier steps with trajectory-aware reward

title: STAPO: Selective Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training

role_in_survey: uncertainty-triggered exploration control in multi-turn RL

role_in_survey: verifier-structure-based credit tracing
